findings.fix: Move the shipping speed choice to the checkout flow.

findings.fix: Increase the button's size to at least 44 pixels in height. Use padding: 12px 16px and font-size: 16px, or match the sizing of the submit button.
findings.violation: The View details button has padding of 1px 2px and font-size of 11px, making it approximately 15-18 pixels tall, much smaller than the recommended 44 to 48 CSS pixels for a mobile fingertip target.

findings.fix: Remove the secondary phone field, or ask for it later when the person updates account preferences.

findings.fix: Choose one label alignment throughout the form. Either remove the display:block style to make all labels inline, or add display:block to all labels to position them above their fields.
findings.violation: The form mixes label positions: most labels have no declared CSS and sit inline beside their fields, while the 'Preferred contact time' label has display:block and sits above its field.
